target.statement: IBQ with codebook size 16,384 and code dimension 256 achieves 1.37 rFID on ImageNet 50k validation set

compute.basis: Training the tokenizer requires 330 epochs on ImageNet with 8 A6000 GPUs (3h40min/epoch per Table 10), which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours.

blockers: Requires training a VQGAN-style tokenizer for 330 epochs on ImageNet, needing GPU compute (8 A6000 GPUs for ~3.7 hours per epoch).
No pre-trained model checkpoint is provided for the exact configuration (16,384 codebook, 256 dim) to directly evaluate rFID.
Evaluation requires generating reconstructions for the entire ImageNet 50k validation set and computing rFID, which is computationally heavy.
title: Scalable Image Tokenization with Index Backpropagation Quantization
